collections.text: The collector’s earlier account identifies Faces as the first of three Nifty Ink series, with 132 numbered drawings, a Christmas special and an origin titled #0000. The numbered sequence runs from October 2021 to May 2022 in the archived records; #0000 was recorded later, in July. The origin title is a special designation, not the chronological beginning.
collections.attribution: Collector’s earlier public gallery; editorial summary with archived date checks where stated.

collections.text: NNOTB stands for New Nifty on the Block, as recorded on the collector’s earlier collection entrance. The archived title family includes the numbered sequence and distinct special or fork drawings. Repeated numbers retain separate drawing identities; title order and recorded creation order remain different ways of navigating the collection.
collections.attribution: Collector’s earlier public gallery; editorial summary with archived date checks where stated.

collections.text: The collector’s earlier account describes Rawblocks as the third Nifty Ink series, with 65 numbered drawings and an origin titled #0000. Its first two works were recorded in May 2022; #3 followed in October, more than five months later. The archive corroborates those calendar dates and records the final numbered work in March 2023.
collections.attribution: Collector’s earlier public gallery; editorial summary with archived date checks where stated.

collections.text: The collector’s earlier account dates Abstract to March 30–April 4, 2022 and lists fifty numbered works, #0000 and #pos. It describes gifts to supporters of nnxyz’s Nifty Ink work, including scrimshaw.eth beside #06. These are preserved historical statements from that account, alongside the recovered images and Polygon token links.
collections.attribution: Collector’s earlier public gallery; editorial summary with archived date checks where stated.

unverifiedHistoricalClaims: Unique complete ownership and unsold-token burns require supporting chain/transaction evidence before publication as verified facts.
The earlier Faces page refers to a complete rawblocks collection in its Faces paragraph; this copy error has not been reproduced.
